title: Fire marshal capacity
excerpt: Attendance may not exceed the posted fire marshal occupancy rating for the room at any time during the event.

title: Food in designated rooms only
excerpt: Food and beverages other than water are permitted only in rooms designated for food service. Instructional classrooms, labs, and library spaces are not designated.

title: Temporary food permit
excerpt: Any event serving or distributing food to attendees requires an approved Temporary Food Permit from Environmental Health & Safety, submitted with the event's date, location, headcount, and food source.

title: Amplified sound after 9 PM
excerpt: Amplified sound after 9:00 PM is permitted only in sound-isolated rooms such as rehearsal studios and designated multipurpose rooms.

title: Residential quiet hours
excerpt: Rooms inside or adjacent to residential communities may not host amplified sound after 8:00 PM.

title: Non-affiliated guests
excerpt: Events open to individuals not affiliated with the university require a campus safety review before confirmation.

title: Guest speaker registration
excerpt: Student organizations hosting a guest speaker must register the speaker with Student Activities & Events.

title: Mid-size event notice
excerpt: Events with more than 50 expected attendees should designate an on-site event lead responsible for crowd flow and room reset.

title: Large event review
excerpt: Events with more than 100 expected attendees require review by Student Activities & Events for staffing, security, and accessibility planning.

title: Alcohol
excerpt: Any event at which alcohol will be present requires prior written approval and cannot be confirmed through self-service booking.

title: Minors on campus
excerpt: Events that include participants under 18 must follow the youth protection program and require staff review.

title: Building hours
excerpt: Events must begin and end within the building's posted operating hours.

title: Accessible space
excerpt: When an organizer indicates that an attendee needs an accessible space, only rooms with an accessible route, entrance, and seating may be assigned.

title: Room availability
excerpt: A room may hold only one confirmed or pending reservation for any given time.

title: Daily booking limit
excerpt: To keep space available to all organizations, each organization may reserve at most 3 hours of space per day.

title: Safety details confirmed
excerpt: A request can be confirmed only after the organizer has stated whether the event involves food, amplified sound, outside guests, guest speakers, alcohol, or minors.
